## What's fixed

- **16:9 menus and scorebug are back to normal.** v1.4.2 shrank the game's 2D graphics a second time on widescreen displays. Team-select ranks ran together ("24TH5TH24TH6TH"), the button labels at the bottom overlapped, and the in-game scorebug was squashed toward the top centre. All of these now look as they did in v1.4. This was tested live on a 2560×1440 display with runners on base.

## Updating

- **From v1.4.2:** choose **Install** in the launcher when v1.4.3 appears, then **Restart**.
- **From v1.4.1 or earlier:** download the package for your system under **Assets** and extract it.

Your disc, saves, settings and installed packs stay where they are.
